aerospikeKubernetesInitNameTag.description: Init container image name with a tag or digest, which must contain a colon (e.g. name:tag or name@sha256:digest). Combined with the registry and namespace to form the full image reference

aerospikeKubernetesInitRegistry.description: Registry to pull the init container image from

aerospikeKubernetesInitRegistryNamespace.description: Registry namespace/organization for the init container image

affinity.description: Pod affinity/anti-affinity and node affinity rules, passed through as-is to the Deployment's pod spec (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

annotations.description: Deployment annotations, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

certs.description: Certificate configuration for the webhook and metrics endpoints

create.description: Create a self-signed certificate for the metrics endpoint

metricsServerCertSecretName.description: Name of the secret holding the metrics server certificate, used when metrics.create is true. Required to be non-empty when metrics.create is true

create.description: Create a self-signed certificate for the webhook endpoint

webhookServerCertSecretName.description: Name of the secret holding the webhook server certificate, always mounted regardless of webhook.create. Webhook certs are mandatory for AKO, so if webhook.create is false this secret must already exist and be provided by the user

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables to inject into the operator container. Names follow the Kubernetes EnvVar validation rules, so letters, digits, '-', '.' and '_', not starting with a digit

failedPodGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period in seconds to delete/recover failed Aerospike pods. Must be a positive integer (silently falls back to 60 if invalid or unset)

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified name used for generated resource names

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as the `additionalProperties` setting would otherwise collide with Helm's special 'global' values key.

healthPort.description: Port for the operator's health probe bind address

healthPortTest.description: Port for the operator's health probe bind address

healthPortTestNew.description: Port for the operator's health probe bind address

healthPortTestNewNew.description: Port for the operator's health probe bind address

ignoreNamespaces.description: Comma-separated (no spaces) list of namespaces ignored by the eviction webhook

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of secrets containing credentials for pulling the operator image from a private registry

labels.description: Deployment labels, inherited by the pods automatically, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration for the operator container, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures needed for the container to be restarted

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the container starts before the first probe

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes needed for the probe to be considered successful after a failure

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which a probe attempt times out

development.description: Zap development mode (--zap-devel). Must always be explicitly set

encoder.description: Zap log encoder (--zap-encoder). Empty leaves the flag off

level.description: Zap log level (--zap-log-level): debug, info, error, panic, or a positive integer for custom verbosity. Empty leaves the flag off

secure.description: Serve the metrics endpoint securely via HTTPS (--metrics-secure). False serves over HTTP instead

metricsPort.description: Port for the operator's metrics bind address

metricsService.description: Service exposing the operator metrics endpoint

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the service, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

labels.description: Extra labels for the service, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in generated resource names

nodeSelector.description: Node labels for pod assignment, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

podAnnotations.description: Pod annotations, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

podLabels.description: Pod labels, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

rbac.description: RBAC resource creation for the operator

create.description: Create RBAC resources and a service account for the operator

serviceAccountName.description: Name of an existing service account to use when rbac.create is false. Required to be non-empty when rbac.create is false

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for the operator container, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures needed for the pod to be marked unready

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the container starts before the first probe

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes needed for the probe to be considered successful after a failure

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which a probe attempt times out

replicas.description: Number of operator replicas to deploy

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the operator container

limits.description: Resource limits for the operator container

cpu.description: CPU limit as a Kubernetes quantity, must be greater than 0 (e.g. 400m, 1)

memory.description: Memory limit as a Kubernetes quantity, must be greater than 0 (e.g. 512Mi, 2Gi)

requests.description: Resource requests for the operator container

cpu.description: CPU request as a Kubernetes quantity, must be greater than 0 (e.g. 10m, 1)

memory.description: Memory request as a Kubernetes quantity, must be greater than 0 (e.g. 64Mi, 1Gi)

safePodEviction.description: Eviction webhook to safely block Aerospike pod evictions during node maintenance. Also enables the Prometheus metric aerospike_ako_eviction_webhook_requests_total (labels eviction_namespace, decision)

enable.description: Enable the eviction webhook to safely block Aerospike pod evictions during node maintenance

timeoutSeconds.description: Eviction webhook timeout in seconds. Must be between 1 and 30 per the Kubernetes ValidatingWebhookConfiguration API

securityContext.description: Container-level security context, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether the operator container may gain more privileges than its parent process

tolerations.description: Tolerations for pod assignment, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

watchNamespaces.description: Comma-separated (no spaces) list of namespaces to watch for Aerospike custom resources. Empty means cluster-wide

webhookService.description: Service exposing the operator webhook endpoint

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the service, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

labels.description: Extra labels for the service, passed through as-is (validated by the Kubernetes API server)

webhookServicePort.description: Deprecated, use webhookService.targetPort instead. Setting this fails chart rendering with a message pointing to the replacement
